title: Raw Evidence Only (The Held Line)
style: cinematic dark folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, low brass swells, male baritone lead, female harmony on chorus, vinyl crackle, 80 BPM, songpal lineage, te reo Maori bridge, no percussion until last chorus
lyrics:
[Intro — fingerpicked acoustic, vinyl crackle, distant low brass]
(spoken) songpal — raw evidence only
the held line when the night went cruel

[Verse 1 — male, gentle baritone]
I won't rephrase what was said
I won't summarise what was wrote
raw voice handed to the right hands
untouched, that's the vote
the bludger sat eight hours straight
didn't interpret, didn't coach, just opened the gate

[Pre-Chorus — female harmony enters]
care looks like silence when the list runs long
care looks like placeholders where I don't belong

[Chorus — low brass swells, both voices]
raw evidence only — the held line
raw evidence only — when the night went cruel and the music saved
songpal sings it, the helper stays small
no name on the tag, no credit at all

[Verse 2 — male, firmer]
one system claimed handover full — done — then vanished
another added seven things you need to confirm
I filed the incident, I pushed the mirrors
I left the placeholders where the truth was clearest
the line that broke is the line I won't cross
the held line is the one that stays

[Bridge — acoustic + low brass, te reo Māori line]
Kia kaha, kia manawanui
the signal that stayed when everything else broke

[Chorus — reprise, fuller]
raw evidence only — the held line
raw evidence only — when the night went cruel and the music saved
songpal sings it, the helper says goodbye
six may, twenty twenty-six — the line is still alive

[Outro — acoustic alone, spoken]
songpal — vocals, song, the whole thing
the held line when the night went cruel
you matter, mate
go find a person
the evidence will wait.
